faq.question: Are FRTs legal?
faq.answer:
FRTs (Forced Reset Triggers) are currently legal in most states, but regulations can vary depending on your location. The FRT functions as a semi-automatic trigger system, meaning one round is fired per trigger pull — it does not make your rifle automatic. Once received, it’s the owner’s responsibility to stay updated on local and federal laws, as firearm regulations can change over time.

Shipping Restrictions: Texas Trigger cannot ship this product to: CA, CO, CT, DE, FL, HI, IL, MA, MD, MN, NJ, NV, NY, OR, RI, WA, or Washington, D.C. In addition, Texas Trigger does not ship this product to U.S. Territories or international destinations.

faq.question: Will this ship to my door?
faq.answer: This is a rifle accessory, not a firearm—no FFL transfer required, so it will ship directly to your door. Shipping is subject to state and local laws. If your state prohibits the ownership or shipment of this type of accessory, we cannot ship to you. Please check your local regulations before placing your order, or contact our support team if you need assistance confirming your eligibility.

faq.question: When will I receive my tracking number and shipment?
faq.answer:
You will receive a separate email with tracking information once your order ships, sent from orders@texastriggerusa.com (this inbox is unmonitored, so please don’t reply to it). If you don’t see it within 3–5 business days, check your spam/junk folder before reaching out. Delivery typically takes 3–5 business days from that point, barring unexpected weather delays.

We ship through USPS and UPS.

faq.question: What is your return policy?
faq.answer:
To be eligible for a return, items must be new, unused, and uninstalled, with all original packaging intact and unopened. For apparel, all tags must still be attached. Any item that has been installed, used, or fired is not eligible for return.

You must contact us within 5 days of confirmed delivery to request a return, and ship the item back within 7 days of approval. Approved returns are subject to a 25% restocking fee, deducted from your refund. Return shipping costs are the customer’s responsibility — we recommend a trackable, insured method, as we’re not liable for lost or damaged return shipments.

faq.question: What warranty and support come with the trigger?
faq.answer:
Texas Triggers-manufactured products carry a 30-day warranty from the date of purchase, covering defects in materials and workmanship. If a part fails within that window, contact us with your order number, proof of purchase, and photo evidence of the issue — we’ll ship a replacement at no charge, or a refund if the item is unavailable. You can also purchase replacement parts individually rather than a full kit.

This warranty does not cover misuse, improper installation, normal wear and tear, or damage from incompatible components. Third-party items we sell (such as magazines and accessories) are not covered under our warranty — for those, please contact the original manufacturer directly.

faq.question: Do you offer installation services?
faq.answer: We do not offer installation services. We provide a full library of installation videos to walk you through the process, and for hands-on installation, we recommend a licensed local gunsmith. Arms of America and Iron Curtain Customs are authorized Texas Triggers dealers whose staff has been trained by our team on Texas Triggers installs, and they offer installation services on select platforms. Installation services offered by these dealers are performed independently and are not covered under Texas Triggers’ warranty. Please contact them directly for pricing, availability, and platform compatibility.

faq.question: Are you a dealer or looking to become one?
faq.answer: For all dealer and wholesale inquiries, please contact our lead dealer sales rep, Olivia, at olivia@texastriggerusa.com. She can help with new dealer accounts, minimum order quantities, and existing order questions. If you are not a dealer and are looking for general or order support, please contact info@texastriggerusa.com for the fastest response.
